Elden Ring old Uchigatana balance recommendation

Game: Elden Ring.

In Elden Ring, the Uchigatana is the strongest weapon in the current latest patch and its optimal bleed build uses Dexterity. This balance recommendation claims the newest patch changed Unsheathe damage and bleed buildup, without an identified verified patch version. It offers damage comparisons for the current meta, rather than stable early-game survival guidance. This page was published years before the acceptance clock.
